title: Outcome
description: data of: outcome.py SESSION --json or outcome.py --night [DATE] --json. What each observation got, from what the run, the stack and the search wrote, against its programme's goals (docs/observing-plan-spec.md, Phase 1).

programme.description: The programme the field belongs to; null for a field none watches.

requested.description: Frames the run was asked for.

accepted.description: Frames the run's own check kept.

stacked.description: Frames in the final stack; null while the stack is pending.

depth_g.description: G where half of planted stars are found; null until depth.py has run.

stalls.description: Gaps between frames more than 30 s beyond the exposure and the camera's usual pace.

owed.description: Candidates first seen here and on no other night: each owed a second look.

goals.description: The programme's [goals]: searchable_frames, worth_depth, desired_frames, desired_depth.
